text:
Aisha (GTM): Quick follow-up from the all-hands — thanks for the clear roadmap call, Dana. Two asks from GTM: 1) can you clarify the near-term priority between chasing expansion in mid-market accounts vs. focusing on fewer enterprise pilot wins? 2) what's the expected timeline for the partner co-sell enablement materials?

Ben (Sales): +1 on prioritization. From the field: deals in pipeline are skewing toward platform pilots that need Dedicated/Private options. If enterprise pilots are the priority, we should freeze new mid-market plays for 30 days.

Carlos (Partnerships): For partner enablement — we have a draft playbook but need product sign-off. Timeline estimate: 3 weeks if product can allocate a review slot; otherwise 6+ weeks. Also want clarity on incentives for partner-led deals (referral vs. co-sell commission).

Dana (CEO): Short answers: 1) Prioritize enterprise pilots that have >=$200k TCV and compliance needs today — that yields better short-term revenue and helps validate Private offering. Mid-market shall continue, but we deprioritize new multi-account plays for 30 days as Ben suggested. 2) Partner enablement — target 3 weeks; we need a small cross-functional sprint.

Aisha (GTM): Thanks. For the 30-day pause, can sales ops publish a simple rule set we can enforce? e.g., `||TCV < 200k && no compliance reqs => mid-market` (hold new plays).

Eli (Product): Re: playbook sign-off — we can carve out 4 hours this Thursday for a review session. Will need the draft + a short list of product calls used in partner demos. Also note: next model release (v3.2) includes latency improvements that materially reduce Dedicated infra cost — that helps our pricing negotiation with enterprise pilots.

Carlos (Partnerships): I'll drop the draft and a 1-pager on co-sell economics into the `#partners` drive by EOD. Thursday review works.

Ben (Sales): Can we get a concrete list of accounts that qualify as pilot fit? Sales ops: please share pipeline view filtered by `>=200k` and `compliance_tags` this afternoon. I'll notify AE leads to pause new mid-market plays.

OpsBot: Recording of the all-hands and slides: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/195300. Slides deck filename: `Q2-GTM-Roadmap.pdf`

Dana (CEO): Action items I want tracked: - Sales ops to publish qualified pilot criteria (due: today end of day). - Partnerships to hand over playbook + commission options (due: EOD today). - Product to provide 30-min sign-off slot and list of demo product calls (due: Thursday). We'll reconvene in the GTM sync next Tuesday with metrics on paused plays and pilot pipeline.

Aisha (GTM): Putting this into the GTM board now. Also can someone confirm whether legal needs to sign off on partner MSA changes for co-sell pilots?

Carlos (Partnerships): Good catch — legal needs to review any changes to partnership terms. I'll loop in Priya (legal) once we have the draft.

Ben (Sales): Quick operational note: recommended play to pause = outbound sequences targeted at mid-market that don't reference Dedicated/Private. Keep inbound and existing mid-market expansion motions running.

Eli (Product): One more note — if enterprise pilots go live, internal priority for a small onboarding SDK (Python + Node) increases. That will shave integration time by ~2 weeks. Will scope after Thursday sign-off.

Aisha (GTM): Perfect. Thanks all. I'll post a short TL;DR in #announcements after Ops confirms the pilot list. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Thread pinned to #all-hands for visibility.
